editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Markets.com is a legitimate, well-regulated CFD broker scoring 7.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. Owned by Finalto Limited — a subsidiary of London Stock Exchange-listed Playtech PLC — and regulated by FCA, CySEC, and ASIC (three Tier-1 regulators), plus FSCA and BVI FSC. The platform offers 2,200+ CFDs across forex, stocks, ETFs, indices, commodities, bonds, blends, and crypto — all with zero commission and zero deposit/withdrawal fees. MT4, MT5, and a proprietary webtrader give you platform flexibility. The 85.4% retail loss rate is transparently disclosed but notably high. Spread betting is available tax-free for UK residents. If you want a clean, well-regulated multi-asset CFD platform without fee complexity — Markets.com delivers. If you need raw ECN pricing or ultra-tight spreads — look at Pepperstone or IC Markets.
